book: Single Latin work, Placaeus's Disputationes de testimoniis et argumentis e Veteri Testamento petitis (Salmur, 1651): a printed index of the disputations, then the text in two sections (disputations I to XXI and XXII to XXXVII) with addenda, a reply to Socinus, and indexes of Scripture citations.
